title: Find the Duplicate Number
description:
[Source: LeetCode 287]
Given an array of integers nums containing n + 1 integers where each integer is in the range [1, n] inclusive. Prove that at least one duplicate number must exist, assume that there is only one repeated number, find this repeated one.

Input Format:
First line: n (size of array)
Second line: n space-separated integers

Output Format:
Duplicate integer
